title: Part 3 — Conversation 8: a contract renewal
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có một quy định kèm ngoại lệ; câu hỏi nhắm đúng vào ngoại lệ.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 53 through 55.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Our cleaning contract runs out at the end of June. Do we automatically renew?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Only if neither side gives notice. Ninety days, so the cut-off would be the end of March.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That's next week. Are we happy with them?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Mostly. The main site is fine. The complaints all come from the Wren Street office, and that's a different crew.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Can we keep the contract but change the crew?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's exactly what I'd ask for. Renewing gives us leverage to raise it — if we let it lapse we start a tender from scratch, and that's three months of work.

questions.prompt: 53. Under what condition does the contract renew automatically?

options.text: If the company is satisfied with the service
If a new tender is not started
If neither party gives ninety days' notice

questions.explanationVi: 'Only if neither side gives notice. Ninety days'.

questions.prompt: 54. Where do the complaints come from?
questions.explanationVi: 'The main site is fine. The complaints all come from the Wren Street office'.

questions.prompt: 55. Why does the man want to renew rather than let the contract lapse?

options.text: The contract cannot legally be ended.
A new tender would take about three months.

questions.explanationVi: 'if we let it lapse we start a tender from scratch, and that's three months of work'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 9: a delayed publication
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Hai nguyên nhân được nêu ra nhưng chỉ một là nguyên nhân chính — câu hỏi phân biệt đúng chỗ đó.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 56 through 58.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The annual report was meant to go out on Friday. Where are we?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Design is finished. We're waiting on the auditors to sign off the figures.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I heard the printers were also short-staffed.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: They were, last week, but they've caught up. It really is just the sign-off now.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: How long once we have it?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Three working days to print and two to distribute. So if we get the sign-off Monday, it lands with shareholders the following Monday.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'll call the audit partner myself this afternoon. That usually moves things.

questions.prompt: 56. What is holding up the report?

options.text: The auditors have not signed off the figures.

questions.explanationVi: 'It really is just the sign-off now'. Nhà in TỪNG thiếu người nhưng đã bắt kịp — bẫy chọn nguyên nhân đã được giải quyết.

questions.prompt: 57. How long will printing and distribution take in total?
questions.explanationVi: Ba ngày in cộng hai ngày phát hành. Phải cộng hai con số, không có câu nào nói thẳng.
'I'll call the audit partner myself this afternoon'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 10: a training request
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Người nói dùng cách nói giảm nhẹ để từ chối một phần — câu hỏi hàm ý nhắm vào đó.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 59 through 61.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I'd like to do the project management certification. It's four days, spread over two months.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: How much is it?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Two thousand two hundred, including the exam.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Right. Well, the training budget for the year is three thousand for the whole team.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: So that's a no.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: It's not a no. It's a not-this-quarter. If you can wait until the new budget in April, I'd support it — and I'd rather fund one proper certification than four half-day courses that change nothing.

questions.explanationVi: 'I'd like to do the project management certification… Two thousand two hundred, including the exam'.

questions.prompt: 60. What does the man mean by 'It's a not-this-quarter'?

options.text: The request is delayed, not rejected.

questions.explanationVi: Ông ta nói rõ 'It's not a no' rồi nêu điều kiện đợi tới ngân sách tháng Tư.

questions.prompt: 61. What does the man say he prefers?

options.text: Several short courses for the whole team

questions.explanationVi: 'I'd rather fund one proper certification than four half-day courses that change nothing'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 11: with a delivery schedule
format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 11, kèm bảng trên đề (câu 62–64)
instructionsVi: Dạng 'Look at the graphic'. Người nói mô tả gián tiếp, bạn phải tự đối chiếu bảng. Đọc bảng TRƯỚC khi băng chạy.
promptEn:
Listen to the conversation and answer questions 62 through 64. Refer to the delivery schedule below where indicated.

DELIVERY WINDOWS — Fairport depot
Route A — Mon & Thu — 07:00–11:00
Route B — Tue & Fri — 11:00–15:00
Route C — Wed only — 07:00–11:00
Route D — Mon–Fri — 15:00–19:00

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The customer says they can only receive goods in the afternoon, and they need it before Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Afternoon rules out the early routes straight away.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: And the one that runs every weekday would work, wouldn't it?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: It would, but it's the most expensive — there's a surcharge for the late window. The other afternoon option is cheaper but only runs twice a week.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Twice a week starting Tuesday. That's still before Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Then take that one and save the surcharge. I'll book it now and email you the reference.

questions.prompt: 62. Look at the graphic. Which route will they book?
questions.explanationVi: Cần buổi chiều nên loại A và C. Trong hai tuyến chiều, họ chọn tuyến rẻ hơn chạy hai lần một tuần và bắt đầu từ thứ Ba — đó là Route B.

questions.prompt: 63. Why do they reject the everyday route?

options.text: It does not run on Tuesdays.
It arrives too late in the week.

questions.explanationVi: 'it's the most expensive — there's a surcharge for the late window'.
'I'll book it now and email you the reference'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 12: a booking problem
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Phân biệt điều khách ĐÒI với điều nhân viên có thẩm quyền làm.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 65 through 67.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I booked a twin room for three nights but you've given us a double. There are two of us travelling for work.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I do apologise. Let me look… you're right, the booking says twin. Unfortunately we're fully occupied tonight.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: So what can you do?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: For tonight, I can offer a second room at no charge, though it's on a different floor. From tomorrow I can move you both into a twin as booked.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: And will you refund tonight's rate for the inconvenience?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I can't authorise a refund at the desk, but I'll log it and the duty manager will call you before ten tomorrow morning.

options.text: The wrong room type was allocated.
The guests arrived a day early.

questions.explanationVi: Đặt phòng hai giường đơn nhưng được xếp phòng giường đôi.

questions.prompt: 66. What does the man offer for tonight?

options.text: A second room free of charge
A voucher for a future stay

questions.explanationVi: 'I can offer a second room at no charge, though it's on a different floor'.

questions.prompt: 67. What does the man say about the refund?

options.text: It is not available in this case.
It must be requested in writing.
The duty manager will call about it.

questions.explanationVi: 'I can't authorise a refund at the desk, but I'll log it and the duty manager will call you'. Không từ chối, chỉ là không đủ thẩm quyền.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 13: three speakers, a website redesign
format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 13, ba người nói (câu 68–70)
instructionsVi: Hội thoại cuối của Part 3. Ba người, có bất đồng được giải quyết bằng một phương án dung hoà ở cuối.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation among three speakers and answer questions 68 through 70.

transcript.speaker: M1
transcript.text: The agency has come back with two options for the website. Full rebuild, or refresh the front end only.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: How much between them?

transcript.speaker: M1
transcript.text: Rebuild is forty thousand, refresh is fourteen.

transcript.speaker: M2
transcript.text: The refresh doesn't fix the checkout, though. That's where we lose people — a third of baskets are abandoned at the payment step.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Then a refresh is money spent on the part that isn't broken.

transcript.speaker: M1
transcript.text: Forty thousand is more than we have this year.

transcript.speaker: M2
transcript.text: Could we rebuild the checkout alone and leave the rest? It's not either-or.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Ask them to quote for that. If it comes in under twenty I think we can make a case for it.

questions.prompt: 68. What problem does the second man identify?
questions.explanationVi: 'a third of baskets are abandoned at the payment step'.

questions.prompt: 69. Why does the woman object to the cheaper option?

options.text: It does not address the actual problem.
The agency has never done one before.
It would still cost forty thousand.

questions.explanationVi: 'a refresh is money spent on the part that isn't broken'.

questions.prompt: 70. What will they ask the agency to do?

options.text: Reduce the price of the full rebuild
Quote for rebuilding the checkout only

questions.explanationVi: 'Could we rebuild the checkout alone… Ask them to quote for that'.
